quest_template.RewardFactionFlags, SuggestedGroupNum, ContentTuningID, QuestPackageID, the honor, title, skill and artifact rewards, RewardChoiceItemDisplayID

the texts a record gives for a player condition (conditionalDescriptions, conditionalCompletionTexts): quest_description_conditional, quest_completion_log_conditional. A quest that has any names them under "unread"
the reward of a treasure picker tools/world/treasure_pickers.json does not name: the picker row is written, no reward item
quest_objectives.Flags is 32 for every objective: what four in five recorded Forever objectives hold, not this quest's own
quest_template_addon beyond the classes (QuestieDB's word, else the class of a class category) and the one quest before it that QuestieDB states

quest_offer_reward and quest_request_items where no recording of the live game has the text in one wording, and their emotes always; quest_details (what the NPC does when it offers the quest), quest_poi
